name: AnyBeat Fitness
summary:
AnyBeat Fitness is made for working out to the music you love. Copy MP3, Ogg or WAV files to your headset and the game listens to each song in a few seconds: it finds the beat, the quiet and the intense parts, and puts targets on the song's drum groove, so a returning chorus brings back its moves. The same song always plays the same workout, so your results compare. Pick Easy, Normal or Hard and which targets to include. 14 songs come with the game, ready to play.

Swing the left bat through the blue target
